falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes above 5,600 on any day within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A new all-time high would invalidate the 'bottom' pattern match, as August 2024's bottom was followed by a grind higher, not an immediate V-recovery to new highs; this suggests the pattern match was spurious and the market structure is stronger than a bottoming formation

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes below 12.00 for 3 consecutive trading days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Sustained sub-12 VIX would indicate complacency and a return to risk-on conditions, directly contradicting a bottoming environment where volatility typically remains elevated or choppy; the August 2024 bottom saw VIX range 16-28

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y-2Y Treasury yield spread inverts further to -75 basis points or wider
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Deepening inversion rather than the steepening that typically accompanies durable bottoms would signal recessionary de-risking is accelerating, not resolving; August 2024's bottom coincided with spread normalization from -35bps toward flat

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
